summary: Backend-only regression for the idempotent seed fix. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_seed_idempotency.py (5 new tests) and re-ran the full pytest suite: 15/15 PASS. Verified end-to-end: (1) snapshot of 370 spells + Palla di Fuoco (id 7f303fb3-4a11-4659-b907-f174f3f38f2a, descrizione 706 chars) taken; (2) created TEST_Idempotency_Alpha_* via POST /api/spells; (3) sudo supervisorctl restart backend; (4) confirmed GET /api/spells?limit=1000 returns exactly 371 (= 370 + 1 test spell) with zero duplicate names (case-insensitive dedupe check); (5) Palla di Fuoco descrizione byte-for-byte identical after restart, livello_num=3, scuola=Invocazione, classi=[mago,stregone] preserved; (6) test spell survived restart, single copy only; (7) backend log after restart contains 'No new spells to seed. Collection has 371 docs.' with NO mention of 'drop'. Also re-verified all existing endpoints (GET /api/spells, /api/spells/meta, /api/spells/suggestions, GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/spells/{id}) still work. Test spells cleaned up in teardown. NOTE: review request mentions Palla di Fuoco descrizione 'should have >1000 chars' — currently it is 706 chars in the DB; this is a user-content observation, not a bug in the fix (the invariant that matters — descrizione must survive restart unchanged — holds).
action_items: None required — idempotent seed fix is verified working. (Optional, carried from prior iterations: migrate FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown handlers to lifespan; silence RN Web shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations.)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed_spells_if_empty(): no db.spells.drop(), no delete_many, no replace_one. Grep confirms the ONLY write is db.spells.insert_many(docs) where docs is filtered by 'name not in existing_names' — truly idempotent.

existing_names is built from a fresh MongoDB scan of nome_italiano (case-insensitive strip+lower) BEFORE the insert loop — races between concurrent restarts are still safe because unique-by-name is enforced at the seed level (though there is no unique DB index on nome_italiano; consider adding db.spells.create_index('nome_italiano', unique=True) as a defense in depth — non-blocking).

Startup backfill (livello_num=-1 OR scuola=='') only $set's parsed metadata (livello_num/scuola/classi) — never touches descrizione or user_edited fields, so user edits are preserved. Verified in the test.
create_index calls are idempotent and safe on every restart.
GET /api/spells excludes _id via projection {'_id': 0} — no ObjectId leak.

Fix in seed_spells_if_empty() now: (1) snapshots existing nome_italiano set, (2) filters raw seed list to only include names NOT already present, (3) uses insert_many only on the filtered new list (or logs 'No new spells to seed' when empty), (4) never calls drop/delete/replace. Verified across a real supervisorctl restart cycle with a user-created spell in place.
